KNOW THE GAME

Every shift has a say.

One shared account. Two independent games. Your Fantasy points stay here.

01

Make $40 million count.

Choose one goalie, two defensemen and three attackers. Starting prices use 2025–26 results. Prices update Mondays at noon Helsinki time: 75% last-season value plus 25% current-season full-season pace, limited to ±5% per week.

02

Two changes. Every month.

Each player replaced uses one transfer. You get two per calendar month in Europe/Helsinki time. Unused transfers expire; your allowance never exceeds two. Picking your first team is free. Sales return the current player value to your cash balance; replacements cost their current price. Your team can grow beyond $40 million.

03

Earn it on the ice.

Only completed regular-season games starting after your entry count. Transfers affect future starts. Past lineups keep the points they earned. Scores refresh daily at noon Helsinki time.
